messages:
mika: Noticing onboarding sampleapp keeps retrying on payload errors; users get a 400 but our SDK surfaces a generic BadRequest so client code retries and triggers rate limits.

adam: Can you paste the server body?

mika: Example: { "error": { "kind": "parse_error", "msg": "metadata must be an object" } } but older infra returns plain text or only status.

zoe: We should give SDKs a small deterministic mapping: map `error.kind` -> typed exception classes (ParseError, ValidationError, AuthError). If missing, fall back to heuristics (Retry-After header for 429, message regex for token/auth).

ravi: Important: add a `retriable` boolean on the exception objects so callers don't have to infer. Also expose `help_url` and a stable `code` string like ERR_PARSE_METADATA.

adam: Minimal change plan: JS/TS SDK will inspect payload.error.kind and throw mapped classes; Go SDK mirror that. Update sampleapp retry logic to only retry when err.retriable === true.

mika: small Node example: `const kind = body?.error?.kind || inferKind(body); switch(kind) { case 'parse_error': throw new ParseError(...); ... }`

zoe: Tests needed: unit tests for mapping, e2e where sampleapp sends malformed metadata and verifies no retry loop. Update mock server fixtures used in CI.

ops-bot: Created ticket DX-999: standardize SDK error mapping and DX-1000: update sampleapp retry policy.

ravi: Who owns TS/Go? adam takes TS, mika takes Go. zoe will update docs sampleapp README and the error FAQ.

mika: I'll also add a changelog line: "SDK: surface ParseError/ValidationError with retriable flag and help_url."

adam: I'll open PR by Thursday. Will include a migration note for apps that relied on generic BadRequest.

zoe: Nice. This should cut the support load and make retry semantics obvious. :white_check_mark:
